craft_notes: Sthāyin: wonder-rest (terrible and not). Rows: row 3 (manifold→wonder). Close: wonder (vismaya as landing: abiding IN wonder). Rejected: choosing terrible OR kind — kept both (ghora/aghorā held together); 'I understand' — kept I-rest (āste: abiding, not knowing).

lines: Dread-natured, most dread, un-dread; named higher-and-lower, neither —
manifold-formed, Śiva's power: beholding, I rest in wonder.
l4.sanskrit_cite: ghorātmikāṃ ghoratamāmaghorāṃ parāparākhyāmaparāṃ parāṃ ca | vicitrarūpāṃ śivayorvibhūtiṃ vilokayan vismayamāna āste

reads_against.argmap: How is power beheld? → Beholding the manifold power — terrible and not — ends in wonder-abiding, not doctrine.
c1_essence: Beholding the manifold power — terrible and not — ends in wonder-abiding, not doctrine.
reads_against.c1_rasa: adbhuta settling toward śānta (wonder worked into rest)
